tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bskor ba'i phan yon legs par bshad pa'i snying po bzhugs/

na mo shākya mu na ye/ spangs rtogs yon tan mthar phyin rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sdug kun nyes bral 'gog lam dam pa'i chos/ /de nyid tshul la sgrub mdzad dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la gus phyag 'tshal/ /mchog gsum rten gyi gzugs brnyan rnam gsum yang*/ /bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing du de dag dang*/ /dbyer med bkur phyag mchod pa'i gnas nyid du/ /gsungs phyir mi phyed dad pas gus pas 'dud/ /mchog dman bar ma'i 'gro kun gyis/ /dge ba bsgrub pa'i tshul mang mod/ /'dir ni gzhan la spro 'phel phyir/ /skor ba'i phan yon grangs bcas bri/ /'di la gnyis/ bskor ba'i phan yon dang*/ grangs tshad sogs bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'dul ba lung gzhi las/ mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems dad pas/ /sangs rgyas mchod rten la ni gom 'dor na/ /'dzam+bu'i chu bo gser kyi srang tshad ni/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa yin/ /zhes dang*/ gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ su zhig dad pas thub pa'i mchod rten nam/ /sku gzugs dag la bskor ba byed pa de/ /phyi ma'i tshe na dgra chen rnams kyi btud/ /bzang po'i snod gyur yon tan rnams dang ldan/ /zhes dang*/ me tog brtsegs pa'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod rten rnams la me tog 'ga' 'bul lam/ zhes pa nas/ mar me phul te phul nas dga' ba'i sems kyis gom pa'i gar stabs bor te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal zhes smra ba de dag ni/ seṅge rnam par rtse ba bskal ba brgya'am bskal ba stong ngam bskal ba brgya phrag stong du yang log par ltung pa'i gnas su 'gyur ba de'i gnas med do/ /zhes dang*/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus lnga brgya'i tha ma la su zhig de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i ring bsrel yungs 'bru tsam la bsti stang byed pa dang*/ bla mar byed pa dang*/

ri mor byed pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ rjed pa dang*/ gsol ba dang*/ bsngags pa dang*/ skor ba byed pa des phan yon lnga yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur te/ lnga gang zhe na/ dran pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang*/ rtogs pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang*/ ngo tsha shes shing khrel yod pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang*/ myur du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mthong bar 'gyur ba dang*/ mthong nas kyang dad pa bskyed par 'gyur ba ste/ phan yon lnga po de dag yongs su bzung bar 'gyur ro/ /de chos bzhi dang ldan par 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa dang*/ de yang ji skad bstan pa bzhin du sgrub pa dang*/ bsgrubs nas kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang nye bar 'gyur ba dang*/ myur du sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par skye bar 'gyur te/ bzhi po de dag go /zhes/ yang de nyid las/ srog chags kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed nas/ /'jig rten mgon gyi mchod rten la/ /su zhig skor ba byed pa ni/ /tshe rabs dag ni thams cad du/ /bya ba spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ /dran dang ldan zhing blo gros ldan/ /bsod nams ldan zhing 'jigs med 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas na ni/ /tshe rabs dag ni thams cad ni/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang*/ /srin po rnams kyis mchod par 'gyur/ / ngas ni gang dag bstan pa yi/ /mi khom brgyad po de dag spong*/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba rab mdzes pa/ /mnyes par byed 'di dal ba gcig /mdog ldan gzugs ni phun sum tshogs/ /mtshan gyis legs par brgyan pa dang*/ /mthu dang stobs dang ldan par 'gyur/ /le lo can du de mi 'gyur/ /de ni phyug cing nor cher 'gyur/ /zhes pa nas/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas na ni/ /skye ba thams cad kun tu yang*/ /dbang cher grags pa'i khyim bdag dang*/ /dpal dang gzi brjid ldan par 'gyur/ /bram ze sā la che ba dang*/ /tshul khrims ldan zhing mang thos dang*/

/rgyal rigs sā la che 'dra dang*/ /phyug cing nor cher ldan par 'gyur/ /ris bskor rgya mtsho tshun chad kyi/ /sa kun la ni gang smon pa/ /gling bzhi dag gi dbang phyug zla/ /rgyal po chos dang ldan par 'gyur/ /'khor los bsgyur ba rdzu 'phrul che/ /rin chen bdun dang ldan par 'gyur/ /rgyal srid gnas nas sangs rgyas la/ /yang dang yang du bsti stang byed/ /'di nas shi 'phos mtho ris su/ /song nas sangs rgyas bstan la dad/ /lhun po'i zom gyi dbang phyug po/ /lha yi dbang po brgya byin 'gyur/ /lha dbang shin tu 'thab bral dang*/ /de bzhin du ni dga' ldan dang*/ /lha dbang shin tu 'phrul dga' dang*/ /dbang bsgyur 'jigs pa med par 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas na ni/ /tshangs pa'i dbang phyug mkhas 'gyur zhing*/ /lha rnams bye bas mchod par 'gyur/ /'jig rten mgon gyi mchod rten la/ /mi gang skor ba byed pa yi/ / bsngags pa bskal ba byed par yang*/ /brjod pas zad par bya mi nus/ /su zhig byang chub sems skyed nas/ /ston pa'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal ba/ /de ni bskal ba bye bar yang*/ /nam yang long zhing 'theng mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten mgon gyi mchod rten la/ /mngon du skor ba byed pa ni/ /bung ba sngon po mdzes 'dra yi/ /rnam par dag pa'i mig 'thob 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas na ni/ /de ni nges par rtag tu yang*/ /mthun pa'i don mthun 'thob 'gyur zhing*/ /don mig rnams ni spangs par 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas na ni/ /mthu dang stobs dang ldan par 'gyur/ /de ni le lo med 'gyur zhing*/ /rtag tu bag yod ldan par 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas na ni/ /brtson 'grus brtan cing mthu brtan la/ /brtan zhing rnam par gnon brtan dang*/ /de ni myur du mkhas par 'gyur/ /me dang dug dang mtshon gyis de/ /nam yang 'chi bus byed mi 'gyur/ /mkhas pa'i tshe ni rdzogs rdzogs su/

/zad par byas nas 'chi dus byed/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas na ni/ /pho brang 'khor dang yul 'khor dang*/ /grong rdal rnams su longs spyod dang*/ /gzugs kyis khyad par 'phags par 'gyur/ /byang chub spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ /de ni 'dod pa mi bsted cing*/ /lus kyang gtsang la gos gtsang zhing*/ /gtsang ma'i chos la gnas par 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ mchod rten bskor ba'i tshigs bcad kyi mdo las/ shes rab chen po shā ri'i bus/ ston pa la ni zhu ba zhus/ /mchod brten bskor ba bgyis pa yi/ /rnam par smin pa ci 'gyur ba/ /bskal ba chen po'i 'jig rten mchog /rnam par 'dren pas bdag la gsungs/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog /ston pas de las bka' stsal pa/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pa yi/ /yon tan gang yin phyogs tsam bstan/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pa yi/ /lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang*/ /lha min mkha' lding mi'am ci/ /lto 'phye rnams kyis mchod par 'gyur/ /dal ba rnyed dka' thob gyur nas/ /skad cig gcig tsam bar du yang*/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pa ni/ /mi khom brgyad rnams spong bar 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /dran dang ldan cing blo gros ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing mdzangs pa dang*/ /thams cad du ni mchod par 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /lha dang de bzhin mi rnams kyi/ /tshe ring ba yang de yis 'thob/ /grags pa chen po'ang 'thob par 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /'dzam+bu'i gling du rus kyi mchog /tshe rigs yongs su dag par yang*/ /blo ldan de ni skye bar 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /kha bzhin dag kyang bzang ba dang*/ /mdog sdug pa dang mkhas pa dang*/ /bde bar gnas pa thob par 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /phyug cing nor yang mang ba dang*/ /ser sna med cing gtong phod dang*/ /sbyin pa dag la dpa' bar 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/

/yid du 'ong zhing lta na sdug /mdog bzang mthong na dga' ba dang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen spyod par 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /'du byed stong par mthong nas kyang*/ /de ni chos la rmongs mi 'gyur/ /myur du dga' ba thob par 'gyur/ / mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /rgyal rigs mchog tu skye bar 'gyur/ /bud med 'khor dang ldan pa dang*/ /stobs dang brtson 'grus ldan par 'gyur/ / mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /bram ze che zhing mtho bar skye/ /tshul khrims ldan zhing thos dang ldan/ /rig byed gsang sngags ldan par 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /khyim bdag che zhing mtho bar skye/ /phyug cing nor yang mang ba dang*/ /nor dang 'bru rnams ldan par 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /'dzam+bu'i gling gi mnga' bdag rje/ /sa steng mtha' dag dbang byed pa'i/ /chos dang ldan pa'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /rin chen bdun dang ldan pa yi/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /chos bzhin 'khor lo bskor bar byed/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /'di nas 'phos te mtho ris 'gro/ /sangs rgyas bstan la dga' ba dang*/ /rnal 'byor ldan zhing rdzu 'phrul che/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /lha yul dag nas 'phos nas kyang*/ /de ni mi yi nang du skye/ /rmongs pa med par mngal du 'jug /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /mngal gyi skyon gyi dri ma yis/ /de la gos par mi 'gyur te/ /de ni nor bu dag pa bzhin/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /ma ltor bde bar gnas par 'gyur/ /de ni bde bar btsa' ba dang*/ /bde bar nu zho 'thung bar 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /phas kyang 'khor g.yog mang po yis/ /de la gso zhing gnas par 'gyur/ /ma mas rtag tu rim gro byed/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /nye du rnams kyi snying du sdug

/de bzhin pha ma lhag par byams/ /skyes nas longs spyod 'phel bar 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /sha za dang ni srin rnams kyis/ /de la gnod par mi 'gyur ro/ /longs spyod dag la skyon med spyod/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /bskal ba brgyar yang de dag rnams/ /zhar ba grum por yong mi 'gyur*/ /lus kyang rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /mig kyang rnam par dag par 'gyur/ /dkyus ring mthon mthing sdug pa dang*/ /lha yi mig kyang de yis 'thob/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /lus bde sems kyang brtan pa dang*/ /de bzhin brtson 'grus brtan pa dang*/ /dpung mgo zlum zhing brtan par 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /stobs dang byad gzugs phun sum tshogs/ /yan lag thams cad mtshan rnams kyis/ /legs par brgyan cing ldan par 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /sum cu rtsa gsum dbang phyug rje/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po brgya byin du/ /lha yi dbang po chen por 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /'thab bral lha yi rgyal po dang*/ /de bzhin yongs su dga' ldan dang*/ /'phrul dga' gzhan 'phrul dbang byed 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten tshangs pa yi/ /dbang phyug nyid du de 'gyur zhing*/ /lha rnams bye ba snyed kyis mchod/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /bskal ba bye ba stong dag dang*/ khrag khrig phrag brgya dag tu yang*/ /shes rab ldan pas rtag tu mchod/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /bskal ba bye ba stong dag tu/ /lus gtsang gos kyang gtsang ba dang*/ /dkar po'i chos dang ldan par 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /stobs dang brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs/ /de ni le lo med pa dang*/ /shin tu bsgrub pa thob par 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /brtson 'grus brtan cing mthu yang brtan/

/rtsal brtan cis kyang mi tshugs shing*/ /don rnams myur du 'grub par byed/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /gdangs skad gsang yang mtho ba dang*/ /yid du 'ong ba'i nga ro can/ /gnod pa med cing nad med 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /nga nyid kyis ni bstan pa yi/ /gnas der myur du de 'gro zhing*/ /shas cher skye ba 'thob par 'gyur/ / mchod rten bskor ba byas pa ni/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi/ /sems gyi tshad med bzhi po dang*/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i dbang yang 'thob/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po dang*/ /dbang po rnams dang stobs rnams dang*/ /byang chub yan lag 'bras bu thob/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /mngon shes drug ldan zag pa med/ /nyon mongs thams cad spangs pa yin/ /dgra bcom rdzu 'phrul chen por 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /'dod chags zhe sdang spangs pa dang*/ /'khor ba rnams ni spangs ba yi/ /rang rgyal byang chub 'thob par 'gyur/ /mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni/ /'jig rten dag tu de bzhin gshegs/ /mtshan rnams kyis ni brgyan pa dang*/ /gser gyi sku mdog 'thob par 'gyur/ /lus kyi las kyang bskor ba yin/ /ngag gi las kyang bskor ba yin/ /yid kyi las kyang bskor ba yin/ / smon lam btab pa bskor ba yin/ /'dir ni bskor ba byas pa yis/ /bgrod dka' bde dgur don rnams 'grub/ /'jig rten mgon po'i mchod rten la/ /bskor ba byas pa'i yon tan gang*/ /de ni tshig tsam nye tshe yis/ /legs par bstan pa mi nus so/ /sems can rnams la snying brtse'i phyir/ /shā ri'i bu yis zhus nas kyang*/ /mchod rten phyag byas yon tan gang*/ /'jig rten mgon pos bstan pa yin/ /rta brgya dang ni gser srang brgya/ /dre mo'i shing rta brgya dag dang*/ /rgod ma brgya yi shing rta rnams/ /rin chen sna tshogs bkang ba yang*/

/ bskor ba'i gom pa gcig bor ba'i/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /gangs kyi glang chen brgya rten dag /lus chen nam tshod yangs pa dang*/ /sna yang gshol mda' 'dra ba'i glang*/ /gser dang nor bus brgyan pa yang*/ /bskor ba'i gom pa gcig por ba'i/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /mkhas pa gang zhig sangs rgyas mchod rten la/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis gom pa gcig bor ba/ /'dzam+bu'i chu klung gser srang 'bum grangs snyed/ /de ni de dang mtshungs pa yod ma yin/ /zhes dang*/ gtsug tor dri med las/ ring bsrel kyi snying po'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi snying po can gyi mchod rten la bskor ba bya'o/ /yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin chen 'di gnyis kyang dus gcig tu dran par bya'o/ /des ni gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum gyi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /bsod nams chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /mtshams med pa lnga'i las kyi sgrib pa rnams kyang yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal ba dang*/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang*/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi ngan song rnams las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe ring bor 'gyur ro/ /sbrul gyi pags pa brjes pa bzhin du lus bor nas skal ba mnyam pa'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang*/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis mchod rten de la bskor ba byas sam/ phyag byas sam/ mchod pa phul yang rung ste de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa ma lus pa yang byang bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang*/ gang la la zhig gis mchod rten 'di la bskor ba byas sam/ phyag byas sam/ thal mo sbyar ram/ me tog phul lam/ byug pa dang bdug pas phul lam/

dril bu dang bdag dang gdugs 'ga' zhig phul na yang de bzhin gshegs pa dgu khri dgu stong gi mchod rten la phul pa'i bsod nams dang mnyam pa yin no/ /zhes dang*/ gsang ba ring bsrel kyi za ma tog las sems can gang dag mchod rten de la bskor ba gcig gam/ phyag 'tshal ba gcig gis mnar med pa la thug pa'i bar la sogs pa rnams las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs mang ngo*/ /mdor na sangs rgyas kyi yung 'bru'i ring bsrel dang*/ chos sku'i ring bsrel gzungs chen sde lngar grags pa sogs rten du song ba'i sku'am/ de lta bu'i ring bsrel gyi snying po can gyi mchod rten la bskor ba byas na sngar bshad pa ltar gyi phan yon rnams 'thob bar 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ ring bsrel gyi snying po can gyi mchod rten la bskor ba bya'o/ /gaṅgā'i klung bye ba khrag khrig 'bum gyi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /mtshams med pa lnga'i las kyi sgrib pa yang byang bar 'gyur ro/ /ngan song du skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /skye ba phyi ma mngal gyi dri mas mi gos par 'gyur ro/ /gang dang gang du skye ba de dang der pad+ma las brdzus te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ /de dag ni bskor ba'i phan yon gtso bor bshad pa yin la/ sangs rgyas kyi sku dngos sam/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba sogs kyi phan yon mang du bshad pa rnams ni 'dir mang du dogs nas mi 'chad de/ gzhan du yang cung zad bris zin cing mtshon tsam ni/ rgyal ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba'i mdo las/ yon tan thams cad thob par 'dod pas dkon mchog gsum la mchod par bya'o/

/zhes dang*/ sa'i snying po'i mdo las/ 'jig rten dag na bde zhing skyid pa/ /thams cad dkon mchog mchod las byung bas/ /zhes sogs dang*/ gzhan yang*/ sangs rgyas yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /zhes pa nas/ bsam mi khyab la dad byas na/ /rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab/ zhes pa'i rkang pa phyi ma gnyis ni bsam mi khyab la mchod byas na/ rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab/ zhes dang*/ bstod pa dang gsol 'debs sogs la bsgyur ba'i phan yon 'byung bar gsungs so/ khyad par du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir de la mchod pa sogs kyi phan yon kyang lhag par bsam kyis mi khyab ste/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ blo gros rnam par dag pa de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su dag pa la su zhig me tog dang*/ phreng ba dang*/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan dang*/ rol mo'i sgra dang*/ byug pa rnams kyis bsti stang byed pa de'i bsod nams kyi phung po'i mtha' rtogs par mi nus te de'i mtha' ni theg pa gsum po gang yang rung bas mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthar thug pa ma gtogs par bsod nams kyi phung po'i phyi ma'i mthar yang zad par mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ blo gros rnam par dag pa ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi tshad med pa de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa la yon phul ba yang tshad med do/ /mtha' yas so/ /bsam gyis mi khyab po/ mtshungs pa med do/ /dpag tu med do/ /grangs med do/ /dpag gis mi lang ngo*/ /brjod du med do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de dag la dad pa gal che ste/ mdo sde thar chen las/ kun nas nyon mongs spangs pa dang*/ /dge ba kun gyi lam bsgrubs te/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin mthong ba la/ /rnam dag dad pa'i dbang gis so/ /zhes dang*/ dkon mchog ta la las/ dad pa gter dag nor dang rkang pa'i mchog/lag pa bzhin du dge sdud rtsa ba yin/ /zhes dang*/

chos bcu pa'i mdo las/ dad pa theg pa'i mchog yin te/ /de ni 'dren rnams nges par 'byung*/ /de phyir blo gros ldan pa'i mis/ /dad pas rjes 'brang nyid la brten/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las kyang*/ dad pa med pa'i skye bo la/ /dka' po'i chos rnams kyi mi skye ste/ /sa bon tsha sgor btab pa las/ /myu gu skye ba med pa bzhin/ /dad pa'i rtsa ba rtag tu chos/ /chos don gzigs pas gsungs pa ste/ zhes gsungs so/ / gnyis pa la gnyis*/ bskor ba'i grangs tshad dang*/ bskor ba bya tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bskor ba'i grangs tshad rdzogs ma rdzogs kyi khyad par 'di ji ltar yin zhe na/ 'di la zhib tu phye na mang yang mdor bsdus zhig brjod par bya ste/ spyir bskor ba'i grangs kyi mtha' tshad ni med de/ bskor ba grangs med pa zhig byas na'ang chog pa'i phyir te/ dper na/ phyag dang mchod pa ci tsam zhig mang du byas kyang rung ba bzhin dang*/ lha'i bsnyen grangs ci tsam zhig mang du byas kyang rung zhing phan yon lhag par che ba bzhin no/ /'on kyang 'dir bskor ba'i grangs kyi tshad bzung ba ni/ dper na sgrub thabs gzhung dag tu lha'i bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad la mi 'dra ba mang du bshad kyang 'bum dang sum 'bum sogs su gsungs pa mang ba las/ 'dir 'bum du gsungs pa ltar rigs 'gre bar/ bskor ba'i grangs chad kyang 'bum gyi dbang du mdzad pa ste/ de yang dgon sde gang yin kyang rang rang gi rten gyi gtso bo gang la byed pa de'i bzhugs khri'am/ pad gdan nam/ skyil dkrung lta bu'i mthar mtho tshad kyis gzhal bar byas nas mtho tshad gang longs kyang*/ mthar dkris gcig 'khor ba'i tshad de skor lam du ci tsam zhig 'khor nas 'bum longs pa na skor tshad re rdzogs par 'jog go /de ni rten gyi gtso bo gang yin de la skor ba 'bum song ba'i dbang du btang yang*/ der ma zad/ rten gyi gtso bo de dad tshad mnyam pa rnams so so la yang 'bul re 'gro zhing*/

gtso bo las chung ba rnams la ni grangs de las mang bar 'gro'o/ /de yang co ne'i dgon 'di'i rten gyi gtso bo gsang 'dus khang gi dbus ma ston pa'i dbang du byas pa'i skor tshad da lta nyis stong lhag tsam zhig 'byung ba 'di bzhin te de bzhin du dgon sde rang rang gi rten gyi gtso bo gang yin ba de la skor ba 'bum 'gro ba'i dbang du btang nas/ skor lam gang yin pa der 'jal dgos pa yin no/ /bskor ba'i grangs tshad mang nyung ni rten 'gangs che mi che dang grags mang nyung gi dbang min gyi/ rten gyi gtso bo de che na bskor grags mang zhing chung na ni grangs nyung bar 'gyur la/ 'on kyang skor lam thag ring mi ring gi khyad par las kyang mang nyung 'byung srid do/ /des na dgon gang yin kyang de nyid yongs rdzogs la bskor tshad re 'grub par byed na ni dgon de'i mthar bskor ba 'bul 'gro dgos so/ /bskor ba'i grangs tshad bshad pa ltar byed rgyu byung na rab ba yin mod/ /de min grangs tshad tsam rdzogs pa la ma bltos te/ nam bskor ba dang grags ci tsam byas kyang chog cing phan yon 'byung ba ni gong du drangs pa'i lung rnams kyis shes so/ /'o na/ bskor ba 'di mchod pa yin nam min snyam na/ mchod pa yin te lus kyi bkur bsti'i mchod pa yin pa'i phyir te/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel pa las/ phyag 'tshal ba dang skor ba byed pa sogs ni bkur stis mchod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mdo sngags kyi gsung rab du ma las bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum skor ba byas nas zhes sogs lta bu bskor ba'i grangs tsam gsungs yang*/ grangs kyi tshad 'di tsam mo zhes gsal bar bshad pa ma mthong yang*/ da lta bskor ba'i grangs tshad 'di ni mkhas pa brgyud pa'i man ngag las 'byung ba ltar bkod pa'o/ /gnyis pa bskor ba bya tshul ni/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i gzhung 'ga' zhig nas du ma zhig bshad kyang 'dir mi 'chad la/ gsar ma'i gzhung nas gsal bar bshad pa ma mthong yang*/

phyag 'tshal ba'i tshe rang lus mang por sprul nas phyag 'tshal ba dang rang gzhan thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal bar mos pa dang*/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe dang gzhan thams cad kyis bzla bar bsam na 'gyur che bar bshad pa ltar/ bskor ba bya ba'i tshe lus mang por mos pa'am/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad lhan cig bskor ba byed par mos na phan yon dang 'gyur che bar gsal lo/ /bskor ba'i dus su kha ton byas gang kyang rung yang lhag tu sgrib pa sbyong ba la yin brgya/ ltung bshags/ mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs sogs dang*/ ma ṇi bzla ba sogs ci rigs bya'o/ /gzhan bskor ba'i 'gyur sngags bzla bar gsungs te rten la skor ba byed pa'i tshe/ na mo da sha dik+ṣi kā la sarba rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥpra dak+ṣa su pra dak+ṣa sarba pā baṃ bi sho dha ni swāhā/ zhes bzla zhing bskor bas sdig pa 'dag par gsungs so/ /rten la phyag bya ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ na mo mañju shrī ye/ na maḥsushrī ṛ ye/ na maḥ.ut+ta mashrī ye swāhā/ zhes brjod nas phyag btsal na phan yon dang 'gyur lhag par che bar bshad do/ /gsungs rab dag las mchod rten la bskor ba bya zhes mang du 'byung ba ni/ sgra dogs pa'i dbang du byas na da lta mchod rten du grags pa rnams la bskor ba bya ba'i don yin kyang*/ sgra yangs pa'i dbang du byas na mchod pa'i rten du gyur ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams la mchod rten zhes sgra bsdus nas brjod pa la bya ste/ de lta na mchod rten dngos kyis mtshon nas sku gsung thugs kyi rten thams cad la mchod rten zhes byar rung bar sems so/ /bsam pa ji lta bus bskor ba ni/ spyir sgo gsum kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba'i ched dang*/ khyad par du ngan sogs las thar 'dod dang*/ 'khor ba spyi las thar 'dod dang*/ sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi bsam bas bskor ba bya ste/ snga ma las phyi ma phan yon lhag par che ba'i phyir ro/ /gal te sku gsung thugs kyi rten gcig tsam la bskor ba byed na'ang de la skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa dang*/

de na rten thams cad bzhugs pa'am/ kun gyis bskor bar bsams te bskor ba byas na ni phan yon lhag par che'o/ /bsam pa 'dzin tshul gyi dbang gis phan yon che chung 'ong bas dad sogs kyi bsam pa rgya che dgos la/ 'on kyang bsam pa legs po 'dzin mi shes par rtsed mo'i tshul gyis bskor ba byas na'ang phan yon 'byung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi stob pa skyed ba'i cho 'grul gyi mdo las/ gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i phyir bzhad gang dam/ ku re'am/ byis pa'i kyal ka'am/ rtsed mor byed pa'am/ 'jim pa las mchod rten de dag thams cad sdug bsngal mthar byas nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang*/ dam chos pad dkar las/ byis pas rtser mor de dag de dag tu/ /gang gi rgyal ba de phyir mchod rten dag/byer ma las ni phung po byas pa yang*/ /de rnams kyis kyang byang chub 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ tshul de phyag mchod skor ba sogs la'ang mtshungs pa'i phyir dang*/ sngon srog chags sbur ba gcig chu rlabs kyis 'khyer nas ring bsrel snying po can gyi mchod rten la stes dbang gis bskor ba gcig byas pa'i dge bas/ phyis sangs rgyas kyi 'khor du skyes nas dgra bcom thob par bshad pas kyang 'grub ba'i phyir ro/ /bzang bzang ston pa bla na med pa des/ /legs legs chos tshul bstan pa mtha' yas kyang*/ mang mang mchog dman bar ma'i 'gro kun la/ /nges nges phan pa phyag mchod skor bar grags/ /sku gsung thugs rten bskor ba'i byin rlabs nyis/ /thog med nas bsags sgo gsum sgrib pa'i mun/ /legs par bsal nas mngon mtho nges legs lam/ /mngon sum mthong bar 'gyur bas skal ba bzang*/ /tshul 'dir sgo gsum 'bad pa'i chu 'dzin las/ /dge legs char rgyun gang zhig bskrun pa de/ /dus gsum dge ba'i klung dang lhan cig tu/ /kun mkhyen rgya mtsho chen por 'jug phyir bsngo/

/ces bskor ba'i phan yon legs par bshad pa'i snying po dad pa'i gzugs brnyan 'char ba'i me long zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ /shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub pa ces bya bas gzhan re gnyis la phan thogs srid snyam ste co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong ngag dbang bkra shis te dad ldan sgom pa byams kyis dad pas par du brkos so// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/bskor ba'i phan yon legs par bshad pa'i snying po bzhugs/ -PAGE 262--PAGE 261--PAGE 246-
